name: Hotel Sonnenhof
beschreibung: Hotel Sonnenhof is peacefully located in the pristine Kaunertal Valley within Tyrol's Landeck district. Operated in authentic alpine tradition, the hotel offers a serene environment for relaxation. In winter, a dedicated ski bus links seamlessly to the Kaunertal Glacier ski resort and Fendels, while summer brings direct access to scenic hiking and biking trails. Amenities include a restorative sauna wellness area, balcony rooms, and regional half-board dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Sonnenhof in the Kaunertal Valley provides peaceful alpine lodging, a sauna wellness area, Tyrolean half-board dining, and a ski bus to the Kaunertal Glacier.
